title: pm-dispatch: one home for tier and effort; the dev tier is derived, never read off the word "contract"; effort is high at most, except two named xhigh cases; no max
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

③ maintainer's direct task · Source: maintainer

Maintainer (Steedos), 2026-11-22, verbatim, in project thread https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBdrFubfZF8Ypz1Sc5VF8kN :

- Q1 07:27Z 「如何优化技能，避免出现类似的问题： 这类卡用 Opus 开发，再由 Fable 做独立的 L2 审核。车队规则本来就是这么写的，#35928 的派单把规则读错了。」
- Q2 07:41Z 「决策分析：Fable，effort high。 也够了」
- Q3 07:41Z 「碰红线的复核用 high。也够了」
- Q4 07:42Z 「高危安全修复：Opus 开发，另起一个 high 的子代理对抗复核。」
- Q5 07:42Z 「感觉没有需要xhigh的地方」
- Q6 07:42Z 「max 我也不会用。」
- Q7 07:43Z 「立一张完整的技能卡，用fable 审核后，现在就派发」
- Q8 07:46Z 「这个不能改：要用 Fable 开发的只有改车队自己规则的卡。 包括 pm-dispatch 的 SKILL.md、os-dev.md、对外发布的 skills/、docs/adr/，」
- Q9 07:46Z 「ADR 修订用 xhigh 同意」
- Q10 07:47Z 「要把规则文字同统一整理一下，避免散落在各处，避免ai犯错」
- Q11 07:47Z 「这个可以派 fable 处理」
- Q12 07:50Z 「高危安全修复的对抗复核，保留 xhigh」 (revises the effort half of Q4; the default-tier build stays)
- Q13 08:00Z, decision card 「定一下：五条新增规则要不要写进技能」, chose 「五条都写」, consequence line as shown: 「开线程前查档位行、线程开工核对实际档、协调者和区线程用 Opus 加 high、总监 effort 用 high，都进第二个 PR，由你批准合并。」

## 维护者速读

- 问题：有两张派单把「改产品契约面」读成了「要用最高档开发」，规则文字散在十几个文件里，说法不一。
- 改法一：档位和 effort 的规则收到一处，其他文件只留指针；容易读错的几句话写明白。
- 改法二：effort 最高用 high，全车队不用 max；xhigh 只保留两处：ADR 修订，和高危安全修复的对抗复核。
- 另有五条新增规则（开线程前查档位行、线程开工核对实际档、三处空白的取值）你已在决策卡上选「五条都写」，走第二个 PR，由你批准合并。

## What happened (read at main `482afcc4`)

- Orders `card-35928.md` and `card-35985.md` (seat `repo:objectstack#7`, 2026-11-22) carried `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, reasons "spec contract surface: a new public endpoint, Clause-② yes widening; coordinator.md 四" and "a new authorable key in packages/spec ⇒ Metadata-protocol: added". Neither quoted a `--tier` line.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --tier <the 60 paths of PR #36316>` prints `no path-derived mandate` and "The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call"; its clause-② note says default-tier build, review at the tier of the face.
- Both threads were in fact opened at the default tier (session records). No ceiling quota was spent; the order and the served tier disagreed and nobody read either.
- The guard `containerModelRefusal` (`dispatch-gates.mjs`, run by `post-stamped.mjs` on a `Claim:` comment) refuses a ceiling `model:` citing neither `MANDATORY` nor `reason:`. For `mode:thread` the claim is posted after the thread is open, no tool reads an order, and any text after `reason:` passes.

## Why it was misread

- `coordinator.md` 四 says 「改协议语义面卡恒 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`」; 协议语义面 is defined only in `execution-duties.md` 派发节. Elsewhere 协议 names the product protocol (`Metadata-protocol`), and `execution-duties.md` 派发节 itself says 「上限…给最重协议/流程/编排卡,按卡取用」 and 「拿不准就升一档」.
- `dispatch-runbook.md` 卡线程节 lists 「改契约:`Clause-②: yes`、`Metadata-protocol` 非 `none`、非测试的 `packages/spec/src/**`」 as what makes a 大卡 (a reason to open a thread). The two orders copied these words as the reason for the tier.
- `dispatch-runbook.md` 「`--tier` 行或难度读数」 is ambiguous about which of the two derives the tier.
- The rule is stated in many files that disagree: `lanes/skills.md` 「pm-dispatch 根恒契约审核档」 against `execution-duties.md` (references-only cards build at the default tier); `lanes/spec.md` and `lanes/server.md` point at a "SKILL.md 模型分档" table that `SKILL.md` does not hold.

## Must not change (Q8)

- 强制条款① and the mandated set stay as on main in meaning: the four surfaces of `MANDATORY_TIER_GLOB_ROWS`, the 协议语义面 definition, the one-line-class exit for `SKILL.md` / `os-dev.md` and its absence for `skills/**` and `docs/adr/**`. The lines may be re-laid in the home; a diff that changes the mandated set or those exits is REWORK.
- ⛔ No edit to `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (frozen, `instrument-discipline.md`; one touched line makes the PR Tier H). The `docs/adr/**` row of `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` also stays: the ADR effort floor it prints still holds (Q9).

## PR 1 — ruled copy (`Rule-change: ruled`)

### A. The dev tier cannot be misread (Q1, Q8)

1. `coordinator.md` 四 states no tier rule of its own (the 协议语义面 sentence goes); it points at the home of section C. The home's first lines say: the build tier is the ceiling only when `--tier` prints a MANDATORY line for the card's paths, or the maintainer's word (a ruling on the card, or a standing tier order) names it; `Clause-②`, `Metadata-protocol` and `packages/spec/src/**` decide whether a thread opens and which L2 review is owed (per `contract-review.md`, not restated), never the build tier.
2. `dispatch-runbook.md` 卡线程节, the 改契约 line: it decides only whether a thread opens, not the tier. The 「`--tier` 行或难度读数」 line: the tier always quotes the `--tier` line; 难度读数 derives effort only.
3. `execution-duties.md` 派发节: reword 「拿不准就升一档」 and 「上限 = 契约审核档,给最重协议/流程/编排卡,按卡取用」 so neither grants a ceiling build without a MANDATORY line or the maintainer's word (Q8 「只有」). Fix `lanes/skills.md` 「pm-dispatch 根恒契约审核档」 (it means `SKILL.md`, not `references/**`). Repoint `lanes/spec.md` and `lanes/server.md` to the home.

### B. Effort (Q2–Q6, Q9, Q12)

4. Decision threads: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, effort `high` (`decision-analysis.md`, `coordinator.md` 五). 「`max` 仅维护者点名」 goes.
5. `execution-duties.md` 派发节:
   - S / nit / text `medium`; M, L and XL `high`; L2 review `high`; design and red-line re-reads `high`; 四轴分析 `high`; a medium-severity security fix `high` (kept); unsure ⇒ `high`, and 「⛔ 不因拿不准给 `xhigh`」 stays.
   - `xhigh` in two places only: an ADR revision (the standing order stands whole), and the read-only adversarial review of a high-severity security fix. That fix is graded by consequence whatever its carrier (an advisory, a private-repo `security` issue, a taken-over card) and is built at the tier `--tier` derives, effort `high`. `security`-labelled cards that fix no finding (deps, UX, copy) go by difficulty.
   - Gone: the unattended-over-30-minutes and measured-gain `xhigh` exits; the `max` clause (keep the epic / p1 half of that line). The measurement line now chooses among `low | medium | high`.
   - Kept: read-only helpers floor `medium`, one-shot lookups `low`.
6. `SKILL.md` claim template (`Container & model` row): the effort slot lists `medium | high`, with `xhigh` only for an ADR revision, said on the same line; a security fix's claim reads `high`, and its adversarial review's `xhigh` is passed to that sub-agent, not claimed; `max` and the timing / measured-record citations go.
7. Out of scope: `packages/qa/scenarios/**` and the `scenario-eval` skill (the runner passes whatever level the CLI accepts; eval rounds are not dispatch defaults). `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` keeps its own QA-runner values (runner cards and disputed-verdict re-checks at `high`; a QA run is not a lane card); only its `xhigh` sentence points at the home.

### C. One home (Q10)

8. Tier and effort rules live in ONE section; every other file points at it and states no tier or effort value. Home: a sub-heading in `execution-duties.md`, cut from the tier and effort lines of 派发节; the section's other lines (dispatch mechanics, ADR bookkeeping, clause ② boundaries, security regression test and so on) stay as they are. It holds (a) by role: session tier and effort; (b) by card type: build tier, review tier, effort; (c) how each is derived (`--tier` stays the only mechanical source; the home keeps the four mandated surfaces and their exits as on main, and names no model). It is written as list lines, not a markdown table (the file's table-row pin is 0).
9. Restatements that become pointers: `coordinator.md` 四 and 五; `decision-analysis.md` (decision-thread effort); `dispatch-runbook.md` (卡线程节 tier lines, the probe tier, the scope-review agent tier); `seat-lifecycle.md` (seat effort); `area-lease.md` (thread effort, option-set review tier); `lanes/l2-review.md`, `lanes/security.md`, `lanes/skills.md`, `lanes/server.md`, `lanes/spec.md`; `triage-duties.md` (triage sub-agent tier); `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` (its `xhigh` sentence); `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`. Also: `SKILL.md` (分诊默认判断档; 天花板档 before 决策线程, twice; the director-tier line), `filing-gate.md` and `os-dev.md` (天花板档决策线程 becomes 决策线程), `dispatch-runbook.md` (the long-thread reader tier), `readings-session.md` (the no-downgrade line), `seat-post-protocol.md` (档位按职责挑). `os-dev.md`'s front-matter `model: opus` stays (pinned by `check:agent-model-declared`). `contract-review.md` keeps the review-tier-by-face rule and the home points at it. `os-dev.md` keeps only what a card thread acts on without reading the skill, and points at the home for values. Rows the home has no ruled value for (coordinator session, director effort) are left out, not invented.
10. Wording in the home: each line names its case and its value; no line needs a second file to be read correctly; 协议 and 契约 are never used for the fleet's own rule files without saying so.

## PR 2 — new rule lines (approved by Q13; lands by the maintainer's approval)

Proposed by the drafting thread and approved as a set by Q13, a decision card in the project thread; that card is the 改规则先立决策卡 step, already answered, so no separate `needs-user-decision` card is owed. The seat records Q13 on this card as the ruling PR 2 cites. PR 2 follows PR 1 (same files) and is not folded into it, so the ruled copy does not wait; it is `Rule-change: yes` and lands Tier H.

11. Before a card thread opens, the coordinator returns to the seat an order whose `model:` names the ceiling with neither a `--tier` MANDATORY line nor a `reason:` naming a ruling (a comment id, or a standing tier order's id and time), and opens no thread. Text only, one sentence in `coordinator.md` 四. A seat can already dry-run its claim draft through `post-stamped.mjs --dry-run --comment=N --file=…`, which runs the same reader.
12. A card thread's first step reads the tier it is served (`readings-session.md`) and compares it with the order; a mismatch in either direction is reported to the seat before any work. The thread's first report to the seat carries the served tier, and the seat writes it into the claim's `Container & model` line.
13. Coordinator session: default tier, effort `high`.
14. Area thread: default tier; a MANDATORY card is built by an isolated ceiling sub-agent or its own thread (`execution-duties.md` 席位档策略).
15. Director seat: tier stays the maintainer's per-project choice (unchanged); effort `high`.

Not in this card: making `readContainerModelLine` check what a `reason:` names. It needs the maintainer's word to open the `dispatch-gates.mjs` freeze and lands Tier H. Known residue in the frozen tool, not touched: `--tier` with no mandate prints "The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call (floor · default · ceiling)"; the `readContainerModelLine` docblock still says an `xhigh` quotes its timing reading.

## Related cards

- #35270 (open, p1, `pm:dispatched`, seat `repo:objectstack#4`): "set effort by the official criteria — xhigh only for long hardest builds and high-severity security fixes". Most of its rule lines are on main. This card agrees with it on the security review (`xhigh`, Q12) and differs on one exit it kept: builds unattended over 30 minutes, or with a measured gain, no longer get `xhigh` (Q5, with only the two exceptions the maintainer then named). That exit was left as it stood by ruling 7073045669 there (only the review sweep was run), not measured. Its ADR-revision question is answered by Q9 (stays `xhigh`). Its measurement record 7073679594 is evidence for the review lines: at 5 old L2 heads, one run per head per level, recall of known major findings 13/18 at `high` against 10/18 at `xhigh`, `xhigh` costing +52% output tokens and 25.8 against 16.6 mean minutes; five runs per level. The seat states on #35270 what is left there (nit N4) and tells its holder.
- #36267 (open, p3, `pm:queue`): the adversarial review keyed on the advisory carrier only. Folded: item 5 keys it on consequence whatever the carrier.
- Follow-up filed in the same act, named in the PR body: `hotcrm` `AGENTS.md` 「Review effort for the maintainer class and for governed paths is `xhigh`; `max` only when he names it」 contradicts this card until changed; a governed PR in that repo.
- Superseded here: the red-line re-read at `xhigh` (decision 二 of ruling record 7024443457, landed by #36254) goes to `high` by Q3. Named in the PR body.
- Closed, read for prior rulings: #25729 (the 2026-10-25 order, `docs/adr/**` at the ceiling tier, effort floor `xhigh`) and #29741 (the 2026-11-03 standing order, docs-only ADR cards at `xhigh`), both kept by Q9; #36266, #32784, #28901, #20250, #21048.

## Acceptance (PR 1)

- Outside the home, no file of item 9 states a tier or effort value (mechanics lines that carry the words without a value are fine); the PR body lists each former restatement and the pointer that replaced it.
- `git grep -n -E 'xhigh|\bmax\b'` over `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` returns `xhigh` only in the home (the ADR-revision rule, the security adversarial review, the 拿不准 prohibition) and in the `SKILL.md` claim template's effort slot; no `max` as an effort level.
- The home's first lines, read alone, answer "does a `packages/spec/src/**` card build at the ceiling?" with no.
- `--tier` on the mandated paths prints what it prints on main; no self-test row changes outside `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`.
- No skill line carries a card number, a comment id or a dated quotation (`filing-gate.md`); the sources live in the PR body.

Acceptance (PR 2): the coordinator step returns, before a thread opens, an order line `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (reason: spec contract surface; Clause-② yes)`; pinned by the written step.

## Dispatch notes

- File surface: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, `references/{coordinator,dispatch-runbook,execution-duties,decision-analysis,seat-lifecycle,area-lease,triage-duties,filing-gate,readings-session,seat-post-protocol}.md`, `references/lanes/{l2-review,security,skills,server,spec}.md`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (rows only). ⛔ not `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, ⛔ not `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`.
- Tier: `--tier` prints MANDATORY for `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, and the maintainer named it (Q11); effort `high`.
- Bytes: `coordinator.md`, `decision-analysis.md`, `execution-duties.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md`, `triage-duties.md`, `lanes/{l2-review,security,skills,server,spec}.md`, `checklist-test/SKILL.md` sit at their ceilings (a repoint that lengthens a line is paid in the same file); `dispatch-runbook.md`, `SKILL.md`, `os-dev.md`, `area-lease.md` within 2–3 bytes. Files that become pointers shrink and lower their rows. The home grows by a ruled raise: the seat first records the quotes above as one ruling comment on this card, and the PR quotes its id and the measured delta. Deletions that pay bytes avoid the phrase pins on these files (`card-pick.mjs`, `check-prior-rulings.mjs`, `fleet-roster.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`).
- PR body: a bare `Rule-change: ruled` line and one `Ruling-ref:` line for PR 1; quotes cited per item by their Q number. The carrier wording of item 5 cites Q4 and Q12 (「高危安全修复」 names no carrier).
- Area / type / grade: `area:fleet` · Task; the seat grades by the `area:fleet` rule of `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` and writes the grading line. Q7 names no grade; a maintainer's direct task jumps the queue by pick order, not by grade.
- Reader: the seat holding `area:fleet` (`repo:objectstack#7`).
- Dedupe (seat's query, open and closed): open #35270, #36267; closed #36266, #32784, #28901, #29741, #20250, #21048. Query terms (search/issues, `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue`): `xhigh effort in:title,body pm-dispatch`; `"CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER" order tier misread`; `"containerModelRefusal"`.
- Review of this card before filing (Q7): an isolated contract-tier agent read it twice against main (`482afcc4`, then `3a81fb75`, no relevant change between).
